njangi.title: Everyone pays in, the pot goes round, everyone benefits.
njangi.p1: In Cameroon, a njangi (also called a tontine) brings neighbours, colleagues and friends together. Each month, everyone puts their share into the same pot, and the whole pot goes to one member, in turn. Nobody keeps the money for themselves.
njangi.p2: On the pitch, the ball is the pot. The pass is the contribution. The goal is the pot paid out.
njangi.p3: But a pot that goes round without ever serving anything dies. So does possession without purpose. Keep the ball moving, yes, as long as it knows where it is going.

books.a: Yes. The {{series}} saga and {{methode}} are free to read online, whatever your plan. So are the method's drills.

data.a: For now, your profile, teams, sessions and matches stay on your device, in your browser. Remember to export a backup from the settings.

cancel.q: Can I stop whenever I want?
cancel.a: Yes, no commitment. You can go back to the free plan at any time without losing your sessions or matches.

federation.q: How does it work for a federation?
federation.a: The national game model, coach education and support are built together with you. The price is set on quote.

pay.a: Payments are not connected yet. Mobile Money and cards are coming. FCFA prices are a guide, at about 600 FCFA to the dollar.

ai.q: Do we have to enter everything by hand?
ai.a: Coding is done on the video: someone taps a button for each action, and every code keeps its moment, so it can be watched again and corrected. That is how analysts work, and it is what gives the Njangi Index. The AI analysis, paid per match, adds an automatic reading of the frames (possession, territory, block, rest defence); it does not count every pass yet. Detecting every action automatically needs image models trained for football: it is on the roadmap.

ai.title: AI match analysis
ai.body: On top of any plan. Claude, Anthropic's AI, reads a frame every few seconds of the match video and estimates possession, territory, the height of the block and the rest defence, with the moments to watch again and a written summary. Payments are not connected yet: an access code is given after payment.

tome1.intro: The first book of the saga: Kaydoudou and BriBri take the ball on a journey from Cameroon to England. Forty chapters, five parts, five countries, one Ball Lesson per chapter.

tome1.artLead: The v2 style of October 2026, in five points.

style.title: A painted, cinematic style
style.body: Cel shading in two or three values, sculpted forms, visible brush texture, a clear key light with a coloured rim light. Warm, joyful and adventurous, for ages 8 to 12.

light.title: One light per country
light.body: Cameroon: gold and red earth. United States: cold blue and floodlights. France: autumn gold and silver grey. Spain: Mediterranean white and turquoise. England: rain, mist and floodlights.

composition.title: Both brothers act
composition.body: One child focal point readable as a thumbnail, a strong silhouette in front of a vast world, and each brother does something that matters. Full-page 2:3, nothing essential near the gutter.

cover.title: One cover system for six books
cover.body: LIONCEAUX in white capitals, the book number in gold Roman numerals, both brothers in three-quarter view and a destination in the distance. The lettering is set separately, never painted.

quality.title: Quality control
quality.body: Any image is redone when identity, age or size drift, when the socks (red on the right, yellow on the left) are swapped, when a shirt is wrong or text appears.

brand.title: The Ndamba brand
brand.lead: The whole identity on one page: the logo, Mola's sign, the colours, the type and the rules of use. It is the reference for the app, the site, the books and anything that will carry the name.

logo.title: The logo
logo.body: The ball and the word “ndamba”, in lower case, always together and in that order. The word is drawn, not typed: never set it again in a font.
logo.onLight: On light backgrounds: green ball, gold star, ink word.
logo.onPitch: On pitch green: chalk ball, gold star, chalk word.

sizes.title: The ball on its own
sizes.body: The ball stands alone when space is short: app icon, favicon, team avatar. It stays readable down to 16 pixels.

construction.title: The construction
construction.a: A ball whose centre panel is the star: the star of the Lions, at the heart of the game.
construction.b: Five points for the five pieces of the Njangi, which the ball learns in each country of the novel.

mola.title: Mola's sign
mola.body: Mola's M is drawn as a passing move: four players, four passes, and the ball arrives. It replaces every sparkle or magic icon, wherever Mola acts.
